name: novax_pwa_ota_v2
description: This project separates the phone controller from the ESP32 hardware firmware.

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=path.join('pwa',req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0]);if(fs.existsSync(f)){let ext=path.extname(f);let m=ext==='.html'?'text/html':ext==='.css'?'text/css':ext==='.js'?'application/javascript':ext==='.svg'?'image/svg+xml':ext==='.png'?'image/png':'text/plain';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end();}}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('NovaX Controller running at http://localhost:8080'));"
